comparison.objective: Lay a dropped kerb and put each mirror-image transition kerb at its correct end.
comparison.physical_skill: Discriminate handed heavy parts, orient them, and seat an ordered kerb layout versus manipulate small tools for controlled fracture and retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly arranged and seated driveway/transition kerbs versus four tangs fractured and contained with hardware preserved.
comparison.reason: Handed layout and heavy placement are materially different abilities. No specs provide line, level, gap, bedding, or damage thresholds.
